<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M, M+1, M+2, etc., with the M+1 peak at ~5.6 % of the monoisotopic peak, which matches the expected 13C contribution for a molecule containing several carbons. No other element exhibits a distinctive isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br) in this data. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
